pairs.why: Both are the same grey safe with a gold dial and matching smooth soft-gloss finish; B's handle is only slightly glossier, which isn't a real difference.
Close to identical; A's dial has cleaner, simpler tick marks, which reads a little more like the smooth, clean finish of the vending machine card.
B's dial has finer ridged grooves that look busier and more detailed, while A's simpler, smoother dial is closer to the real cards' moderate smoothness.
The two are almost the same in shape, light and finish, so there's no meaningful difference to pick between.
There's no visible difference in rendering, gloss level or construction between A and B.
Both safes have the same smooth matte-to-soft-gloss metal and gold hardware, so neither is closer to the real cards.
Only tiny dial differences; finish and light are equal and both fit the real cards about equally well.
B's dial has extra fine radial grooves that add texture, while A's cleaner dial better matches the smoother real cards.
